items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: He introduced me to Clark Monroe

ctx.x:
Yes, yes. So I went to Basie and he just took a liking to me, you know. And he introduced me to James P. Johnson. He introduced me because he was from Red Bank, New Jersey, you see, and he had played in New York in his younger days. He had played all around New York, everybody knew him in New York. And him and Sonny Greer were good buddies, you know. And Kaiser Marshall, all of them knew Basie.

So when I went to New York and when I joined Basie's band, he took me everyplace. He introduced me to Clark Monroe, he…

introduced me to everybody, you know. And what a thrill it was to meet James P. Johnson. And all the people that I had read about and admired, and never had the slightest idea that I would be shaking hands with them. I met them through Basie, you know.
